entities.name: Andronicus of Rhodes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andronikos of Rhodes was a Greek philosopher from Rhodes who was also the scholarch (head) of the Peripatetic school. He is most famous for publishing a new edition of the works of Aristotle that forms the basis of the texts that survive today.
